0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Kohm Noskh gazes upon you with sorrowful eyes.

48.original: Tiny traveler... Thou hast traversed the great expanse to stand before me. I ask thee─on thy journey, didst thou find strength?

49.original: None here have been spared the torment of loss...yet even tragedy cometh not in equal measure.

50.original: Nay, of all my kin, the broodsires feel it most deeply. Eggs crushed before their eyes, hatchlings twisted beyond recognition...they cannot be blamed for turning to madness.

51.original: One I would have you slay, for mine own power sufficeth not to end her suffering. She yet wandereth, restless, near the ash-choked lake, though naught but poison is to be found there now...

52.original: The lake lieth beyond the vitrified fort. End the broodmother's suffering, I beg thee...

53.original: Thou... Thou art the murderer of my children!

54.original: Long... So long have I been weary...

55.original: Thy countenance speaketh volumes... I thank thee.

56.original: The metal demons struck without warning... Beautiful and pitiless as falling stars.

57.original: We fought, yes... Yet for all our savagery, we failed to protect the young. What few survived emerged from their eggs disfigured and screaming...

58.original: Would that fate had taken a different course. We might have welcomed them to this world together, and guided them unto a brilliant future...

61.original: There are still dragons on my star.

62.original: I have encountered young dragons in my travels.

63.original: So the young have found their place elsewhere... Our kind shall live on.

64.original: I am gladdened to hear not all was in vain. May thy path lead thee true, traveler.
